---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem / 問題

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected?
（這個功能要解決什麼問題？誰會受益？）

> Example: "When I have 50+ users, the user list is slow to scroll because there's no pagination."

## Proposed Solution / 提議方案

Describe what you'd like to see.
（描述你希望加入什麼功能。）

## Alternatives Considered / 其他方案

Have you considered other approaches? Why is this one preferred?

## Scope Check / 範圍檢查

This feature fits in (check one):

- [ ] **CE (Community Edition)** — foundational admin functionality
  - Examples: auth, RBAC, i18n, layouts, logging, basic CRUD UX
- [ ] **EE (Enterprise Edition) — possibly out of scope for this repo**
  - Examples: AI integration, schedulers, SSO, advanced audit / analytics
- [ ] Not sure — let's discuss

## Additional Context / 其他資訊

Mockups, links to similar features in other tools, related issues.

---

**Before submitting:**
- [ ] I searched [existing issues](https://github.com/easeforge/ap-base/issues?q=is%3Aissue) and didn't find a duplicate
- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) on what fits CE vs. EE
